name: Triceratops Necromancer
source:
A lonely ice mage develops a crush on her healer while fighting the undead. Everything goes terribly wrong. Also they're dinosaurs.

[From [url=https://sadvnsfromtom.itch.io/triceratops-necromancer]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名孤独的寒冰女法师在与亡灵大军作战的过程中，暗恋上了队伍里的治疗师。随后一切彻底失控崩盘。顺带一提，她们全都是恐龙。

[摘自[url=https://sadvnsfromtom.itch.io/triceratops-necromancer]itch.io[/url]]
